summary: FortexaERP sync button feature fully tested. Backend APIs (11/11 tests passed) and frontend UI all working correctly. The 'Sincronizar con FortexaERP' button now appears in the Accounting module's export dropdowns for both Journal Entries and Payroll Summary tabs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FortexaERP sync button feature fully implemented and tested. The button appears in export dropdowns when ERP is configured. To see the button: 1) Go to Company Config > Integrations, 2) Configure FortexaERP with API URL, Company ID, Email, Password, 3) Save config, 4) Go to Accounting page, 5) Click export dropdown on any journal entry - FortexaERP option will appear after Summary and Detailed options.

GET /api/fortexaerp/sync-status/{period_id} returns synced=false for unsynced period
